findings.title: endOfDay now returns the start of the next day
findings.body: The new implementation sets `end` to `startOfDay(day)` and then adds one day, so `endOfDay` returns the start of the next day instead of the end of the current day. This breaks the function's documented intent and likely callers that expect the last millisecond of the given day.

summary.problem: endOfDay now returns the start of the next day instead of the end of the current day.
summary.done_well: The refactor reuses startOfDay to avoid duplicating date logic.
